5-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (37-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Planning Ahead' va YASHIL yorliqda oq '5'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)'.
• Qalin: 'Look at the Photo File section and complete the letter Robin sent to his friend.'
18) 'Use the prompts to act out dialogues, as in the example.' Qiya ro'yxat: correct it, replace it, heat it up, clean it.
   SURAT: restoranda oq ko'ylakli va galstukli ofitsiant stol yonida turibdi; stolda oq sochli ayol va kulrang kostyumdagi erkak, oldilarida taomlar va bokallar. To'rtta rangli gap pufakchasi suratga ishora qiladi:
     - YaShIL: 'glass/be/chipped'
     - KO'K (yuqorida): 'table/be/dirty'
     - KO'K (o'ngda): 'bill/be/wrong'
     - PUShTI (pastda): 'soup/be/cold'
   O'ngda ko'k qiya namuna: 'SA: The glass is chipped. SB: Sorry, madam. I'll replace it for you.'
19) 'Underline the correct words in bold in the dialogue below.' A (Alan?), P (Pam) va T (Tim) o'rtasidagi dialog, sakkizta qalin variant juftligi.
20) 'Complete the short dialogues below with WILL, WON'T, IS GOING TO or AM GOING TO.' (oxirgi uchtasi qiya harflarda). Beshta qisqa dialog, nuqtali joylar.

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
21) a) 'Read the advertisement below, then use the prompts to make questions.'
   E'LON: ko'k fonda oq katta harflar 'DISCOVER SRI LANKA'. Ostida PUShTI-shaftoli fonli, ko'k uzuq chiziqli ramka:
     'A TEN-DAY TOUR OF SRI LANKA FOR ONLY £800! (11TH SEPTEMBER → 21ST SEPTEMBER)'
     'Price Includes:'
     - Return Flight from Heathrow
     - 10 nights in 5-star accommodation
     - 10 breakfasts, lunches and dinners
     - Daily sightseeing tours with experienced local guide
     'For further information or reservations, call World Travel Co. at (0181) 4978214, 29 South Street, London'
   E'LON ustiga BESh oq pufakcha, har biri tegishli qatorga strelka bilan ishora qiladi:
     - 'leave in morning, afternoon or evening?' (Return Flight)
     - 'own room, or share?' (accommodation)
     - 'vegetarian dishes available?' (breakfasts, lunches, dinners)
     - 'speak English?' (local guide)
     - 'what sights? time for shopping?' (sightseeing tours)
   b) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and fill in the missing words.'
   XAT (yirtiq qog'oz shaklida, burchagi qayrilgan, sarg'ish fonda qo'l yozuvi shriftida):
     'Dear Sir/Madam,'
     [to'q sariq '1' strelkasi] 'I am 1) ......... regarding your advertisement in The Broadmoor Weekly on 20th April. I am very interested in visiting Sri Lanka and 2) ......... be grateful if you could answer a 3) ......... questions.'
     [to'q sariq '2' strelkasi] 'Your advertisement states that the price includes a return flight 4) ......... Heathrow. Will the flight leave in the morning, afternoon or evening? The advertisement also mentions that the price includes ten nights in five-star accommodation. Will I have my own room, or will I 5) ......... to share? In addition, regarding the meals that the price includes, will vegetarian dishes be available? Finally, what sights will we visit on the daily sightseeing tours? Will there be time to go 6) .........? Also, will the guide speak English?'
     [to'q sariq '3' strelkasi] 'Thank you for your help. I look 7) ......... to hearing from you.'
     'Yours faithfully, Darren Barnet'
   c) 'Read the letter and answer the questions.' Oltita savol; 6-savol ostida qiya: 'closing remarks - questions - reason for writing'.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '37'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to act out dialogues, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
RESTORANDA ShIKOYaT QILISh.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: The glass IS CHIPPED.
  SB: Sorry, madam. I'LL REPLACE it
      for you.


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'I'LL'?

  Ofitsiant ShIKOYaTNI ENDI eshitdi
  va ShU ZAHOTI qaror qildi →
  'will' (on-the-spot decision).

  ⚠ 'I'm going to replace it' -
  NOTO'G'RI bo'lardi, chunki oldindan
  rejalashtirmagan.


TO'RT ShIKOYaT va TO'RT JAVOB:

  glass/be/chipped → replace it
     (bokal chetlangan → almashtiraman)
  table/be/dirty → clean it
     (stol iflos → tozalayman)
  bill/be/wrong → correct it
     (hisob noto'g'ri → to'g'rilayman)
  soup/be/cold → heat it up
     (sho'rva sovuq → isitaman)


⚠ 'CHIPPED':

  = cheti singan, uchgan.
  ⚠ 'a chip' = kichik parcha.
  ⚠ Idish cheti sinsa 'chipped'
  deyiladi.


⚠ 'TO HEAT UP':

  = isitmoq (ovqatni).
  ⚠ 'heat it UP' - olmosh 'heat' va
  'up' ORASIGA tushadi.
  ⚠ 'heat up it' - XATO!


⚠ 'THE BILL':

  Britaniyada 'the bill',
  AQShda 'the check'.
  ⚠ 'Can I have the bill, please?'


⚠ 'MADAM' va 'SIR':

  Xizmat ko'rsatishda hurmatli
  murojaat.
  ⚠ 'madam' → ayolga,
  'sir' → erkakka.

items.question: SA: The glass is chipped.
items.answer: SB: Sorry, madam. I'll replace it for you.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi namuna.
⚠ 'I'LL' - shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror.

items.question: SA: The table is dirty.
items.answer: SB: Sorry, madam. I'll clean it for you.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'clean it' - ko'rsatmalar ro'yxatidan.
⚠ Olmosh 'it' fe'ldan KEYIN.

items.question: SA: The bill is wrong.
items.answer: SB: Sorry, sir. I'll correct it for you.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'the bill' - Britaniyada hisob.
⚠ 'to correct' = to'g'rilamoq.

items.question: SA: The soup is cold.
items.answer: SB: Sorry, madam. I'll heat it up for you.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'heat IT up' - olmosh O'RTAGA tushadi.
⚠ 'heat up it' - XATO!

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct words in bold in the dialogue below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogdagi qalin so'zlardan to'g'risining tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Great party, Pam! By the way,
     what 1) ARE YOU GOING TO do
     after graduation?
  P: 2) I'M GOING TO travel around
     Australia for a year. Actually,
     3) I'M PICKING UP my ticket
     tomorrow. I can't wait! What
     about you?
  A: I'm not sure. Maybe 4) I'LL work
     for my father for a while, but
     after that, I don't know.
     Hang on, let me get a drink ...
  P: 5) I'LL get you one. What would
     you like?
  A: 6) I'LL have a glass of Coke,
     please.
  P: Okay. Oh, was that the doorbell?
     Tim, 7) WILL you open the door,
     please?
  T: Sure.
  P: Thanks. 8) I'LL bring you your
     Coke.


⚠ HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1 'are you going to' - REJA
    haqida so'rayapti
  2 "I'm going to" - oldindan
    o'ylangan REJA
  3 "I'm picking up" - ANIQ
    kelishilgan ish ('tomorrow')
  4 "I'll" - 'MAYBE' + 'I'M NOT SURE'
    → aniq emas
  5 "I'll" - ShU ZAHOTI taklif qildi
  6 "I'll" - ShU ZAHOTI buyurtma berdi
  7 'will you' - ILTIMOS
    ('Will you ...?' = iltimos qilish)
  8 "I'll" - ShU ZAHOTI va'da berdi


⚠ 'WILL YOU ...?' - ILTIMOS:

  'Will you open the door, please?'
  = Eshikni ochib bering, iltimos.
  ⚠ 'Are you going to open ...?'
  bu yerda MOS EMAS - u REJA haqida
  so'ragan bo'lardi.


⚠ 'BY THE WAY':

  = aytmoqchi, darvoqe.
  ⚠ Yangi mavzuga o'tishda.


⚠ 'GRADUATION':

  = bitiruv (o'quv yurtini tugatish).
  ⚠ 'to graduate FROM university'.


⚠ 'HANG ON':

  = shoshma, kut.
  ⚠ 'Hold on' ham xuddi shu ma'noda.


⚠ "I CAN'T WAIT!":

  = Sabrim chidamayapti!
  ⚠ Katta hayajonni bildiradi.


⚠ 'FOR A WHILE':

  = bir muddat, bir oz vaqt.


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = olib kelmoq, olib ketmoq.
  ⚠ 'pick up my ticket' = chiptamni
  olib kelmoq.

items.textEn: A: Great party, Pam! By the way, what 1) ___ do after graduation?
items.whyUz:
⚠ REJA haqida so'rayapti → 'be going to'.
⚠ 'Will you do?' iltimos ma'nosini berardi.

items.textEn: P: 2) ___ travel around Australia for a year.
items.uz: Bir yil Avstraliya bo'ylab sayohat qilaman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Oldindan o'ylangan REJA → 'be going to'.
⚠ 'around Australia' = Avstraliya bo'ylab.

items.textEn: P: Actually, 3) ___ my ticket tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ANIQ kelishilgan ish + aniq vaqt ('tomorrow')
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

items.textEn: A: I'm not sure. Maybe 4) ___ work for my father for a while.
items.uz: Aniq emas. Balki bir muddat otamning yonida ishlarman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'MAYBE' + "I'M NOT SURE" → ANIQ EMAS →
'will'.
⚠ Reja emas, faqat taxmin.

items.textEn: P: 5) ___ get you one. What would you like?
items.uz: Men senga olib kelaman. Nima xohlaysan?
items.whyUz:
⚠ ShU ZAHOTI taklif qildi → 'will'.
⚠ Taklif har doim 'I'll' bilan.

items.textEn: A: 6) ___ have a glass of Coke, please.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ShU ZAHOTI buyurtma berdi → 'will'.
⚠ 'I'll have ...' - buyurtma berishning odatiy
qolipi.

items.textEn: P: Tim, 7) ___ you open the door, please?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Will you ...?' = ILTIMOS.
⚠ 'Are you going to open?' REJA haqida
so'ragan bo'lardi - mos emas.

items.textEn: P: Thanks. 8) ___ bring you your Coke.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ShU ZAHOTI va'da berdi → 'will'.
⚠ Va'da har doim 'will' bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the short dialogues below with will, won't, is going to or am going to.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni will, won't, is going to yoki am going to bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh QISQA DIALOG.


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 A: Your appointment is at nine
       tomorrow morning.
     B: Don't worry. I WON'T be late.
     ⚠ VA'DA (inkor) → "won't".

  2 A: I'm hungry.
     B: I'LL make an omelette for you.
     ⚠ ShU ZAHOTI TAKLIF → 'will'.

  3 A: Your shirt is dirty.
     B: I know. I'LL wash it later.
     ⚠ ShU ZAHOTI QAROR → 'will'.

  4 A: Why is Steve wearing his shorts?
     B: He IS GOING TO play football
        with Bill.
     ⚠ OLDINDAN o'ylangan REJA +
     DALIL ko'rinib turibdi (shorti
     kiygan) → 'be going to'.

  5 A: Did you post those letters this
       morning?
     B: Oh, I forgot! I'LL post them
        tomorrow.
     ⚠ ShU ZAHOTI QAROR ('Oh, I
     forgot!') → 'will'.


⚠ ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:

  Faqat 4-BAND 'is going to'.
  Qolganlarida odam gapirayotgan
  PAYTDA qaror qiladi → 'will/won't'.

  ⚠ 4-bandda Stiv REJANI ALLAQAChON
  qilgan - shorti kiyib olgan!


⚠ 'AN APPOINTMENT':

  = uchrashuvga yozilish (shifokor,
  sartarosh).
  ⚠ 'to make an appointment' =
  navbat olmoq.
  ⚠ Oddiy do'stona uchrashuv emas -
  u 'a meeting' yoki 'a date'.


⚠ 'AN OMELETTE':

  ⚠ Imlosi qiyin: o-m-e-l-e-t-t-e.
  ⚠ AQShda 'omelet'.


⚠ 'SHORTS':

  ⚠ HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA (trousers,
  jeans kabi).
  ⚠ 'a shorts' - XATO;
  'a pair of shorts' ✓.


⚠ 'TO POST' va 'TO MAIL':

  Britaniyada 'to post a letter',
  AQShda 'to mail a letter'.

items.textEn: A: Your appointment is at nine tomorrow morning.  B: Don't worry. I ___ be late.
items.whyUz:
⚠ VA'DA (inkor) → "won't".
⚠ "won't" = 'will not'.

items.textEn: A: I'm hungry.  B: I ___ make an omelette for you.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ShU ZAHOTI TAKLIF → 'will'.
⚠ "I'll make" deb qisqartiriladi.

items.textEn: A: Your shirt is dirty.  B: I know. I ___ wash it later.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ShU ZAHOTI QAROR → 'will'.
⚠ Oldin rejalashtirmagan edi.

items.textEn: A: Why is Steve wearing his shorts?  B: He ___ play football with Bill.
items.whyUz:
⚠ REJA ALLAQAChON qilingan (shorti kiygan) →
'is going to'.
⚠ BIRGINA shu bandda 'going to'.

items.textEn: A: Did you post those letters this morning?  B: Oh, I forgot! I ___ post them tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Oh, I FORGOT!' - endi esladi va ShU ZAHOTI
qaror qildi → 'will'.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAYoHAT E'LONI - TO'LIQ MATNI.


⚠ 'SRI LANKA':

  Hindiston janubidagi orol davlat.
  ⚠ Poytaxti - Kolombo.


⚠ '£800':

  = 'eight hundred pounds'.
  ⚠ '£' belgisi SONDAN OLDIN
  yoziladi, lekin KEYIN o'qiladi.


⚠ 'A TEN-DAY TOUR':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan, 'day' BIRLIKDA.
  ⚠ 'a ten-days tour' - XATO.
  ⚠ 35-betdagi 'a 21-year-old' bilan
  bir xil qoida.


⚠ 'A RETURN FLIGHT':

  = borish-qaytish reysi.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'a return ticket',
  AQShda 'a round-trip ticket'.
  ⚠ Faqat borish - 'a single'
  (Britaniya) / 'one-way' (AQSh).


⚠ 'HEATHROW':

  Londonning eng katta aeroporti.


⚠ '5-STAR ACCOMMODATION':

  = 5 yulduzli turar joy.
  ⚠ 'accommodation' - Britaniyada
  SANALMAYDIGAN!
  ⚠ 'accommodations' - AQShda.
  ⚠ Imlosi: ikki 'c' VA ikki 'm'.


⚠ 'SIGHTSEEING':

  = diqqatga sazovor joylarni
  ko'rish.
  ⚠ 'sight' (manzara) + 'seeing'.
  ⚠ 'to go sightseeing' - turg'un.


⚠ SANA O'QILIShI:

  '11TH SEPTEMBER' → 'the eleventh
  of September'
  '21ST SEPTEMBER' → 'the
  twenty-first of September'

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to discover' = kashf etmoq.
⚠ Buyruq shakli - e'lonlarda odatiy.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the advertisement below, then use the prompts to make questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi e'lonni o'qing, so'ng ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib savollar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh PUFAKChA - SAVOLGA AYLANTIRISh.


⚠ HAMMA SAVOL 'WILL' BILAN:

  Chunki bu sayohat KELAJAKDA
  bo'ladi.

  WILL + ega + FE'L ...?


TO'LIQ SAVOLLAR (xatdagidek):

  1 'leave in morning, afternoon or
     evening?'
    → 'Will the flight leave in the
       morning, afternoon or
       evening?'

  2 'own room, or share?'
    → 'Will I have my own room, or
       will I have to share?'

  3 'vegetarian dishes available?'
    → 'Will vegetarian dishes be
       available?'

  4 'what sights? time for shopping?'
    → 'What sights will we visit?
       Will there be time to go
       shopping?'

  5 'speak English?'
    → 'Will the guide speak English?'


⚠ 'WILL THERE BE ...?':

  ⚠ 'There is/are' ning KELASI
  ZAMONI - 'There WILL BE'.
  ⚠ Savolda: 'WILL THERE BE ...?'
  ⚠ 'Will there have ...' - XATO.


⚠ 'TO SHARE':

  = birga foydalanmoq, bo'lishmoq.
  ⚠ 'to share a room' = xonani
  birov bilan bo'lishmoq.


⚠ 'AVAILABLE':

  = mavjud, bor.
  ⚠ Otdan KEYIN yoki 'be' bilan:
  'Are vegetarian dishes
   available?'


⚠ 'A SIGHT':

  = diqqatga sazovor joy.
  ⚠ 'What sights will we visit?'
  ⚠ 'a site' (joy, maydon) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG - talaffuzi bir xil!

items.prompt: ertalab, tushdan keyin yoki kechqurun jo'naydimi?
items.question: Will the flight leave in the morning, afternoon or evening?
items.answer: Will the flight leave in the morning, afternoon or evening?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WILL' + ega + fe'l.
⚠ 'IN the morning/afternoon/evening'.

items.prompt: o'z xonam bo'ladimi yoki birov bilan bo'lishamanmi?
items.question: Will I have my own room, or will I have to share?
items.answer: Will I have my own room, or will I have to share?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'my OWN room' = o'zimning xonam.
⚠ 'to share' = birga foydalanmoq.

items.question: Will vegetarian dishes be available?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WILL' + ega + 'BE' + sifat.
⚠ 'available' = mavjud.

items.prompt: qanday joylarni ko'ramiz? xaridga vaqt bo'ladimi?
items.question: What sights will we visit? Will there be time to go shopping?
items.answer: What sights will we visit? Will there be time to go shopping?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WILL THERE BE' - 'there is' ning kelasi
zamoni.
⚠ 'a sight' = diqqatga sazovor joy.

items.question: Will the guide speak English?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WILL' + ega + fe'l.
⚠ 'English' - til nomi, KATTA harf.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and fill in the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY XAT - TO'LIQ MATN.


1-XATBOSHI (reason for writing):

  'I am WRITING regarding your
  advertisement in The Broadmoor
  Weekly on 20th April. I am very
  interested in visiting Sri Lanka
  and WOULD be grateful if you could
  answer a FEW questions.'


2-XATBOSHI (questions):

  'Your advertisement states that the
  price includes a return flight FROM
  Heathrow. ... Will I have my own
  room, or will I HAVE to share? ...
  Will there be time to go SHOPPING?
  Also, will the guide speak English?'


3-XATBOSHI (closing remarks):

  'Thank you for your help. I look
  FORWARD to hearing from you.'
  'Yours faithfully, Darren Barnet'


⚠ 'I AM WRITING REGARDING ...':

  Rasmiy xatning STANDART boshlanishi.
  ⚠ 'regarding' = haqida, xususida
  ('about' ning RASMIY shakli).


⚠ 'I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF YOU COULD
   ...':

  Juda muloyim iltimos qolipi.
  ⚠ 'Please answer' dan ANChA
  rasmiyroq.


⚠ 'A FEW QUESTIONS':

  ⚠ 'a FEW' - SANALADIGAN otlar bilan
  (a few questions).
  ⚠ 'a LITTLE' - sanalmaydigan bilan
  (a little water).
  ⚠ 'a' oldindan turgani uchun 'few'
  yagona to'g'ri javob.


⚠ 'I LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM
   YOU':

  Rasmiy xatning STANDART tugashi.
  ⚠ 'to' dan keyin -ING shakli!
  'look forward to HEARING'
  ⚠ 'look forward to hear' - XATO!
  Bu yerdagi 'to' PREDLOG, infinitiv
  belgisi emas.


⚠ 'YOURS FAITHFULLY' va
   'YOURS SINCERELY':

  Dear Sir/Madam → Yours FAITHFULLY
  Dear Mr Brown → Yours SINCERELY

  ⚠ Ism NOMA'LUM bo'lsa 'faithfully'.
  ⚠ Xat 'Dear Sir/Madam' bilan
  boshlangani uchun 'faithfully'
  to'g'ri.

items.textEn: I am 1) ___ regarding your advertisement in The Broadmoor Weekly on 20th April.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'I am WRITING regarding ...' - standart
boshlanish.
⚠ 'regarding' = 'about' ning rasmiy shakli.

items.textEn: I am very interested in visiting Sri Lanka and 2) ___ be grateful if you could answer a few questions.
items.whyUz:
⚠ "I WOULD be grateful if you could ..." -
muloyim iltimos qolipi.
⚠ 'I'd be grateful' deb qisqartiriladi.

items.textEn: ... if you could answer a 3) ___ questions.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a FEW' - SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.
⚠ 'a little' sanalmaydigan bilan bo'lardi.

items.textEn: Your advertisement states that the price includes a return flight 4) ___ Heathrow.
items.whyUz:
⚠ E'londa 'Return Flight FROM Heathrow'.
⚠ Reys QAYERDAN uchishi → 'from'.

items.textEn: Will I have my own room, or will I 5) ___ to share?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'will I HAVE to share?' - 'have to' ning
kelasi zamoni.
⚠ 'will I must' - XATO! 'must' dan keyin
boshqa modal kelmaydi.

items.textEn: Will there be time to go 6) ___ ?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to go SHOPPING' - 'go' + -ING
(go swimming, go fishing, go dancing).
⚠ 'to go to shopping' - XATO.

items.textEn: Thank you for your help. I look 7) ___ to hearing from you.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'I look FORWARD TO HEARING from you.'
⚠ 'to' PREDLOG → keyin -ING shakli.
⚠ 'look forward to hear' - XATO!

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY XAT TUZILIShI - TAHLIL.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 Has the writer included all
    points mentioned in the prompts?
    → YES, he has. Barcha besh
    pufakcha savolga aylantirilgan.

  2 How does the writer start the
    letter?
    → With 'Dear Sir/Madam,' and
    'I am writing regarding your
    advertisement ...'

  3 How does he finish it?
    → With 'I look forward to hearing
    from you.' and 'Yours
    faithfully, Darren Barnet'

  4 Is the letter formal or informal?
    How can you tell?
    → FORMAL.
    Belgilar:
      • qisqartmalar YO'Q
        ('I am' - "I'm" emas)
      • rasmiy so'zlar: 'regarding',
        'states', 'mentions',
        'In addition', 'Finally'
      • muloyim qoliplar:
        'I would be grateful if you
         could ...'
      • 'Dear Sir/Madam' +
        'Yours faithfully'

  5 How many paragraphs are there?
    → THREE (3).

  6 Which heading matches each
    paragraph?
    → 1-xatboshi: REASON FOR WRITING
      2-xatboshi: QUESTIONS
      3-xatboshi: CLOSING REMARKS


⚠ RASMIY XAT UCh XATBOShIDAN:

  1) Yozish sababi
  2) Asosiy qism (savollar/talab)
  3) Yakuniy so'zlar


⚠ RASMIY va NORASMIY FARQI:

  RASMIY:
     I am writing / I would be
     grateful / regarding / Yours
     faithfully

  NORASMIY:
     I'm writing / Can you tell me /
     about / Love, Best wishes


⚠ 'TO STATE' va 'TO MENTION':

  to state = qat'iy aytmoq, bayon
     qilmoq
  to mention = eslatib o'tmoq

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 2-xatboshida bor.


⚠ 'IN ADDITION' va 'FINALLY':

  Rasmiy bog'lovchilar:
     In addition = bundan tashqari
     Finally = nihoyat, oxirida


⚠ 'CLOSING REMARKS':

  = yakuniy so'zlar.
  ⚠ 'a remark' = izoh, gap.

points.en: 1 Has the writer included all points mentioned in the prompts? — Yes, he has. All five prompts have been turned into questions.
points.uz: 1 Muallif ko'rsatmalardagi barcha bandlarni kiritganmi? — Ha. Beshta pufakcha ham savolga aylantirilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq, kiritmoq.
⚠ 'mentioned' = eslatilgan.

points.en: 2 How does the writer start the letter? — With 'Dear Sir/Madam,' and 'I am writing regarding your advertisement ...'
points.uz: 2 Muallif xatni qanday boshlaydi? — 'Dear Sir/Madam,' va 'I am writing regarding your advertisement ...' bilan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Dear Sir/Madam' - ism NOMA'LUM bo'lganda.
⚠ Vergul bilan tugaydi.

points.en: 3 How does he finish it? — With 'I look forward to hearing from you.' and 'Yours faithfully, Darren Barnet'
points.uz: 3 Xatni qanday tugatadi? — 'I look forward to hearing from you.' va 'Yours faithfully, Darren Barnet' bilan.

points.en: 4 Is the letter formal or informal? — It is formal. There are no short forms, and it uses words like 'regarding', 'states', 'In addition' and 'I would be grateful if you could ...'
points.uz: 4 Xat rasmiymi yoki norasmiymi? — Rasmiy. Qisqartmalar yo'q va 'regarding', 'states', 'In addition', 'I would be grateful if you could ...' kabi so'zlar ishlatilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ QISQARTMA YO'Q - rasmiy xatning eng aniq
belgisi ('I am', "I'm" emas).

points.en: 5 How many paragraphs are there? — There are three.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a paragraph' = xatboshi, abzats.
⚠ Xatda to'q sariq 1, 2, 3 strelkalari bilan
belgilangan.

points.en: 6 Which heading matches each paragraph? — Paragraph 1: reason for writing. Paragraph 2: questions. Paragraph 3: closing remarks.
points.uz: 6 Qaysi sarlavha har bir xatboshiga mos? — 1-xatboshi: yozish sababi. 2-xatboshi: savollar. 3-xatboshi: yakuniy so'zlar.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Rasmiy xat HAR DOIM shu uch qismdan iborat.
⚠ 'a heading' = sarlavha.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Shikoyat, va'da va rasmiy xat qoliplari.

patterns.formula: The [narsa] is [sifat]. - Sorry, madam. I'll [fe'l] it for you.
patterns.exampleEn: The glass is chipped. - Sorry, madam. I'll replace it for you.
patterns.exampleUz: Bokal chetlangan. - Kechirasiz, xonim. Sizga almashtirib beraman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ofitsiant ShU ZAHOTI qaror qiladi → "I'll".
⚠ Olmosh 'it' fe'ldan keyin.

patterns.exampleEn: Will you open the door, please?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Will you ...?' = ILTIMOS, reja haqida savol
EMAS.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't worry. I won't be late.
I am writing regarding your advertisement in The Broadmoor Weekly.
patterns.exampleUz: The Broadmoor Weekly'dagi e'loningiz yuzasidan yozyapman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Rasmiy xatning STANDART boshlanishi.
⚠ QISQARTMA YO'Q: 'I am', "I'm" emas.

patterns.formula: I would be grateful if you could [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: I would be grateful if you could answer a few questions.
patterns.exampleUz: Bir necha savolga javob bersangiz, minnatdor bo'lardim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Eng muloyim iltimos qolipi.
⚠ 'a FEW' - sanaladigan otlar bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: I look forward to hearing from you.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to' PREDLOG → keyin -ING!
⚠ 'look forward to hear' - XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: Will there be time to go shopping?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'There is/are' ning kelasi zamoni -
'There will be'.

groups.explanationUz: E'londagi 'a ten-day tour' va '5-star accommodation' shu qoidadan.
